value.message: Kids & Me at Halton Hills Public Library's Acton branch runs Thursdays 10:30-12:00, free - their site says. It's also offered Tuesdays 9:30-11:00 at St. Andrew's United Church in Georgetown, per Halton Region. Links2Care also lists free EarlyON drop-in centres in Acton and Georgetown for birth to age 6, though no schedule was posted.
